Owls hunt at night. They have big eyes that help them see in the dark. Owls can turn their heads almost all the way around.

Image: A photo shows an owl perched on a branch. Its two large, round yellow eyes face forward.

What does the photo show?
items.answer: The photo shows an owl with two large, round yellow eyes.

Bears sleep through most of the winter. This is called hibernation. Before winter, bears eat a lot of food to store energy.

Image: A drawing shows a bear curled up inside a dark cave surrounded by snow outside the entrance.

What does the drawing show the bear doing?
items.answer: The drawing shows the bear sleeping inside a cave during winter.

The sun is a star. It gives Earth light and heat. Earth travels around the sun once every year.

Image: A diagram shows a large yellow circle labeled 'Sun' in the middle and a small blue circle labeled 'Earth' with a dotted oval path around the sun.

What does the dotted oval path in the diagram show?
items.answer: The dotted oval path shows the route Earth travels around the sun.

Ants live underground in colonies. They dig tunnels to make rooms for sleeping, storing food, and raising young ants.

Image: A diagram shows a cross-section of the ground with tunnels leading to three separate rooms. One room is labeled 'Food Storage,' one is labeled 'Nursery,' and one is labeled 'Queen's Chamber.'

What does the diagram show about how ants live?
items.answer: The diagram shows the tunnels and rooms ants build underground.

Rainbows appear in the sky after rain. They have seven colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet.

Image: A photo shows a colorful arc in the sky with bands of color over a green field.

What does the photo help you see?
items.answer: The photo shows what a rainbow looks like in the sky with its bands of color.

The heart pumps blood through your body. It beats about 70 times every minute. You can feel your heartbeat if you press your hand to your chest.

Image: A diagram shows a heart with arrows pointing away from it in all directions, labeled 'blood flowing out to body.'

What do the arrows in the diagram show?
items.answer: The arrows show blood flowing out of the heart to the rest of the body.

Trees grow from seeds. A seed sprouts into a seedling. The seedling grows into a young tree, and then into a full-grown tree.

Image: A diagram shows four pictures in a row: a small seed, a green sprout, a small tree, and a large tree.

What does the diagram show?
items.answer: The diagram shows the four stages of how a tree grows from a seed.

The ocean is home to many creatures. Fish, whales, dolphins, and sharks all live in the ocean. The ocean covers most of Earth's surface.

Image: A photo shows a large blue ocean with waves. In the distance, a whale's tail is visible above the water.

What does the photo show from the article?
items.answer: The photo shows the ocean and a whale, which the article says lives in the ocean.

Clouds are made of tiny water droplets floating in the sky. There are different types of clouds. Fluffy white ones are called cumulus clouds. Flat gray ones are called stratus clouds.

Image: Two photos are shown side by side. The left one shows large, fluffy white clouds. The right one shows a flat, gray layer of cloud covering the whole sky.

What are the two types of clouds shown in the photos?
items.answer: The photos show cumulus clouds (fluffy and white) and stratus clouds (flat and gray).

The library has many sections. Books for children are in one area. Computers for research are in another area. Librarians sit at a desk to help visitors.

Image: A simple map of the library shows a 'Children's Books' section on the left, a 'Computers' section on the right, and a 'Help Desk' in the center.

What does the map tell you about the library?
items.answer: The map shows where the children's books, computers, and help desk are located in the library.

Image: A close-up photo shows the feathers of a blue and green bird. Each feather has a pointed tip and a central spine with smaller branches coming off it.

What detail does the close-up photo show?
items.answer: The photo shows the details of how a feather is shaped, with a central spine and smaller branches.

The pyramids of Egypt were built thousands of years ago. They were tombs for ancient Egyptian rulers called pharaohs. The Great Pyramid is one of the largest structures ever built.

Image: A photo shows three large stone pyramids in a sandy desert under a blue sky.

What does the photo show about the pyramids?
items.answer: The photo shows that the pyramids are very large stone structures standing in a desert.

Worms live in soil and are very helpful. They eat dead leaves and plant material. As they move through the soil, they create tiny tunnels that let air and water reach plant roots.

Image: A diagram shows a side view of soil with a worm tunneling through it. Small dotted lines show tunnels the worm has made. Arrows show air and water moving down through the tunnels toward plant roots.

What does the diagram show about how worms help plants?
items.answer: The diagram shows that worm tunnels let air and water reach plant roots underground.

Volleyball is a team sport. Two teams of six players stand on opposite sides of a net. Players hit the ball over the net, trying to make it land on the other team's side.

Image: A diagram shows a rectangle split down the middle by a line labeled 'net.' On each side are six circles representing players.

What does the diagram show about the game?
items.answer: The diagram shows how the court is divided by a net with six players on each side.

Snow forms when water vapor in clouds freezes into tiny ice crystals. The crystals stick together to form snowflakes. Every snowflake has a six-sided shape.

Image: A close-up photo shows a single snowflake with six arms, each covered in tiny branching points. It looks like a star.

What does the photo show about snowflakes?
items.answer: The photo shows that a snowflake has six arms arranged like a star.
